components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast next-step action used to advance through the report.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:42px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid #e7e8e3; border-radius:7px; background:#e7e8e3; color:#121413; cursor:pointer; font:650 13px 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; transition:transform .17s ease, filter .17s ease, outline .17s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); filter:brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #84d7a0; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet companion action for navigation and secondary choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height:42px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid #393d3a; border-radius:7px; background:#191c1a; color:#ced0cc; cursor:pointer; font:600 13px 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; transition:transform .17s ease, border-color .17s ease, color .17s ease, outline .17s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); border-color:#646964; color:#fff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #84d7a0; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:none; }

components.name: Active Filter Chip
components.description: Selected state for dossier, activity, and chart view filters.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid #2c4a37; border-radius:20px; background:#2c4a37; color:#e9fbef; cursor:pointer; font:560 13px 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; transition:border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease, outline .15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#84d7a0; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #84d7a0; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Evidence Search
components.description: Searches the evidence ledger without leaving the report.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" aria-label="Search evidence" placeholder="Search evidence, sessions, projects…">
components.css: .ds-search { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid #353936; border-radius:7px; background:#151816; color:#f0f1ed; font:400 13px 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; transition:border-color .15s ease, outline .15s ease; } .ds-search::placeholder { color:#666b67; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #84d7a0; outline-offset:3px; border-color:#84d7a0; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Step navigation for the guided report sequence.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:block; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:11px 14px; text-align:left; border:1px solid transparent; border-left:2px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:#7d817d; cursor:pointer; font:400 13.5px 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; transition:background .16s ease, color .16s ease, outline .16s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color:#c5c8c3; background:#151816; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { color:#f0f1ed; font-weight:560; border-left-color:#84d7a0; background:#151816; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #84d7a0; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Dossier Card
components.description: Expandable finding that keeps observation, action, and evidence together.
components.css: .ds-dossier-card { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #292c2a; border-radius:7px; background:#141715; transition:border-color .15s ease; } .ds-dossier-card:hover { border-color:#3a3e3b; } .ds-dossier-toggle { width:100%; padding:18px 20px; text-align:left; border:0; background:transparent; color:#e7e8e4; cursor:pointer; font:540 17px/1.32 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; transition:outline .15s ease; } .ds-dossier-toggle:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #84d7a0; outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-dossier-kicker { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:#8a8e89; font:600 12px/1.2 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; }

components.name: Metric Group
components.description: Compact tonal container for archive and session measurements.
components.css: .ds-metric-group { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #292c2a; border-radius:8px; background:#151816; color:#f0f1ed; } .ds-metric-group h2 { margin:0; padding:14px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid #292c2a; color:#b7bab6; font:600 13px 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-metric-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; padding:10px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid #242725; font:400 12px 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-metric-row:last-child { border-bottom:0; } .ds-metric-row span { color:#898d89; } .ds-metric-row b { color:#f0f1ed; font:500 11px 'DM Mono',monospace; }

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: Search result row that expands to reveal the original excerpt.
components.css: .ds-evidence-row { display:block; width:100%; padding:15px 17px; border:0; background:#141715; color:#f0f1ed; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease, outline .15s ease; } .ds-evidence-row:hover { background:#191c1a; } .ds-evidence-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #84d7a0; outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-evidence-row strong { display:block; margin-bottom:5px; font:520 14px/1.35 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-row span { color:#777c77; font:400 11px 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Farpoint's visual system is a dark evidence ledger: quiet, exacting, and generous with the data. The local report stages conclusions as a guided sequence—recommendation first, then findings, activity, and evidence—so it feels like an instrument for review rather than a generic dashboard. Mint is a signal for direction, confidence, and interaction; it is deliberately rare against the dark field.

The surface is built from near-black tonal layers, hairline borders, restrained radii, and a compact sans/mono pairing. Instrument Sans gives conclusions an editorial, human voice; DM Mono is reserved for measurements, ordinals, and technical metadata. The terminal companion keeps the same green-led intent with an Ink-native palette and text-first controls.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence before ornament: data and supporting excerpts remain the visual focus.
Dark, layered, and local: surfaces distinguish context without relying on heavy shadows.
Signal-led interaction: mint marks active navigation, links, selected states, and progress.
Editorial data density: large, tightly set headings sit above compact labels and metrics.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Mint should identify what is active, actionable, or verified; it should not become a general-purpose background color.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Separate report surfaces with nearby dark values and hairlines before reaching for additional accent colors.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Use Instrument Sans for meaning and DM Mono for measurement. Do not set explanatory paragraphs in mono.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Large headings use compressed tracking and short line-height; supporting prose restores generous line-height and muted contrast.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: A surface is flat at rest. Use tonal layering and borders to establish hierarchy; reserve movement and emphasis for interaction or evidence state.

dos: Do lead report journeys with one concrete next move before exposing the full archive.
Do keep recommendations, findings, metrics, and evidence visually related but distinguishable through tonal layers.
Do use mint for active, actionable, or verified states and maintain a visible focus treatment.
Do reserve DM Mono for values, ordinals, and compact technical metadata.
Do preserve the 900–1080px reading widths for dense report content and stack the system at the documented breakpoints.
Do keep the report local-first and evidence-forward in any new surface language.
donts: Don't turn the report into a colorful analytics dashboard with a new accent for every metric.
Don't use shadows, glow, or decorative imagery to manufacture hierarchy that tonal layers already provide.
Don't hide supporting evidence behind vague claims or replace evidence labels with raw session IDs.
Don't use the terminal palette as if it were the web report palette; the surfaces have intentionally distinct values.
Don't set body copy, recommendations, or explanatory findings in DM Mono.
Don't remove keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, or the compact mobile navigation treatment.
